title: Design of covalent organic framework based heterojunctions to inhibit photogenerated carrier dynamics for ultralow recombination and improved photocatalytic hydrogen production
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,4638-4648
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00653H, Paper
Hai Liu, Huijun Zhang, Zhen Yuan, Fei Jin, Zhiliang Jin
In this study, the donor-acceptor photocatalyst TT-TPDACOF was synthesized. Co2CuS4 was incorporated to strategically engineer a p–n heterojunction structure and prevent charge carrier recombination. The resulting photocatalyst presents significantly enhanced hydrogen evolution performance.
